anomalies.detail: pointer is 0x0000 (no text). ids < 0x300 are routed to the old resolver; id 0x300 is the first extended id and reads the null pointer. Recorded as the empty/boundary slot.

the entry begins with the terminator byte 0xF3 (loader test at $03:EBBF returns immediately). id 0x347 ends with "$F2" whose $F3 is the shared boundary byte at ROM 0x1186D0, and the pointer of 0x348 points at that same byte, so 0x348 renders empty while its text (24 dead bytes after the leading F3) stays unreachable through this id. Flagged for the rebuild to decide, not fixed here.

no F3 inside their own slice; the loader continues into the next entries until the next F3. The optimizer changed {F2F3} into {F2F7} on ids 186/187/189/18A and ends id 274 with a lone $F2; the original JP tables have no such entries.
